title: Guna Yala and the rising sea: an island community moves to the mainland
goal: Talk about Guna autonomy and the climate move of 2024, using por más que.
grammar: concessive clauses with por mas que and subjunctive

sections.title: Guna Yala and the rising sea: an island community moves to the mainland
body: In this lesson you read about the Guna people and their comarca on the Caribbean coast, and about Gardi Sugdub, an island community that moved to the mainland in 2024 because of the rising sea.
The grammar is one you know: *por más que* for "however much". The screens and instructions are in English; the readings are in Spanish.

items: I can say that nothing changes however much something happens, with *por más que* and *por mucho que*.
I can say who governs Guna Yala and when the Guna rose up.
I can use the new words for comarcas, islands and the sea.
